content.title: WWE WrestleMania 42 Sunday start time, match card
content.text: Sean Rueter has been thinking too much about pro wrestling since at least WrestleMania I, and blogging about it for SBNation & Cageside Seats since around WrestleMania 28.WWE will return to ESPN Unlimited in the United States — and Netflix everywhere else — tonight (Sun., April 19, 2026) with their biggest premium live event of the year, WrestleMania!Night Two of WrestleMania 42 will feature four more title matches, culminating in the years-in-the-making one-on-one clash between Roman Reigns and CM Punk for the latter’s WWE World Heavyweight championship.The event will get rolling at 3 p.m. Eastern with the free Countdown show, which runs for three hours on WWE and ESPN’s online outlets, among other places. That leads right on into the premium live event at 6 p.m. Eastern, which in the United States starts on ESPN with two matches (Brock Lesnar vs. Oba Femi, and the Men’s Intercontinental Championship Ladder Match between champion Penta and Je’von Evans, Dragon Lee, JD McDonagh, Rusev, and Rey Mysterio), then after an hour moves to ESPN’s new streaming platform. Everywhere else (or if you take new Hall of Famer Stephanie McMahon’s advice), it’s on Netflix.WrestleMania 42 Sunday Match CardWWE World Heavyweight ChampionshipCM Punk (c) vs. Roman ReignsWWE Women’s ChampionshipJade Cargill (c) vs. Rhea RipleyMen’s United States ChampionshipSami Zayn (c) vs. Trick WilliamsGrudge Match“The Demon” Finn Balor vs. Dominik MysterioSingles MatchOba Femi vs. Brock LesnarWWE Men’s Intercontinental Championship Ladder MatchPenta (c) vs. Je’von Evans vs. Dragon Lee vs. JD McDonagh vs. Rusev vs. Rey Mysterio1 Comment
